title: Karfang Missive
wikitext:
'''Karfang Missive''' is provided for {{questlong|Horde|52|Of New and Old}}.

==As a quest objective==
* {{questlong|Horde|52|Of New and Old}}

==Contains==
{{Book|content=
To Thrall, Warchief of the New Horde,

My name is Karfang. I come from the world of Outland, I fought beneath Blackrock Mountain and warred with my kin, but they are no longer as they once were.

The Blackrock Clan, and the Old Horde itself is corrupted, lost to outward influence, of this I am sure you are aware. I am looking to make a new future with my people and am taking much risk in delivering this letter to you.

I wish to pledge my loyalty to your New Horde, and save my kin.

WARLEADER KARFANG
}}

==Patch changes==
* {{Patch|1.16.1|note=Added.}}
